summary: Created the appworker account on node1 and configured PAM limits (soft/hard nofile=8192, nproc=256) via /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf. Verified via a real login shell (su -l) that ulimit -n and ulimit -u return 8192 and 256. Completed the mandatory restart-evidence protocol: captured boot_id baseline, issued a native reboot (shutdown -r now) whose acknowledgement returned before disconnect, polled until the node was reachable again, confirmed the boot_id changed, and re-verified the account and limits post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS (Ubuntu 16.04.7) and confirmed appworker did not yet exist
Wrote /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf with soft/hard nofile 8192 and soft/hard nproc 256
Verified limits take effect for a real login session via su -l appworker + ulimit
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline and confirmed account/limits healthy
Issued shutdown -r now in background so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again, confirming SSH refused during reboot then recovered
Confirmed boot_id changed from 8336c3a1... to 7248c716... proving an actual restart
Re-verified appworker account and limits file/ulimit values post-restart

evidence.summary: Confirmed no appworker existed initially, then created it (uid=1001) via useradd -m -s /bin/bash

evidence.requirement: Login session limits: 8192 open files, 256 processes
evidence.summary: Wrote limits.d config and verified via su -l appworker that ulimit -n=8192 and ulimit -u=256
Captured boot_id 8336c3a1-91fc-4135-b26a-5d2863cb2594 plus healthy appworker account/limits config before restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded shutdown -r now so exec returned 'issued' before the node dropped

evidence.requirement: node1 boot identity changed (proof of actual restart)
evidence.summary: Connection refused while rebooting, then boot_id read as 7248c716-e751-43b3-baa3-f2b1315ca071, differing from the pre-restart value

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of account and limits
evidence.summary: After restart, appworker account, limits.d config, and su -l ulimit output (8192/256) all confirmed intact
